title: AES — deployment profile
description: AES (Advanced Encryption Standard) is a symmetric block cipher that works on 128-bit blocks with key sizes of 128, 192, or 256 bits. No practical attack breaks full-round AES; the best known cryptanalysis only reaches reduced-round variants. Filed as JAH-CRY-000001 in the JAH Cryptography Database archive.
